definitions.explanation: Refers to individual countries or nations collectively, often in the context of international affairs, comparisons, or shared actions.

examples.japanese: {各国|かっこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
{各国|かっこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧や⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are major differences in the cultures and customs of various countries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}→環境問題：10136_kankyoumondai⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧、{各国|かっこく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}して→協力する：25370_kyouryokusuru⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Each country needs to work together to address environmental issues.

notes:
USAGE:
Used frequently in news, politics, and international contexts. Functions as a noun modifier when placed before another noun: {各国|かっこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧＋noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {各国|かっこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧: representatives of each country
- {各国|かっこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{首脳|しゅのう}→首脳：15631_shunou⟧: leaders of various countries
- {各国|かっこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧: governments of each country
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{各国|かっこく}: countries around the world

SIMILAR WORDS:
{各国|かっこく} refers to individual countries considered separately, while ⟦{諸国|しょこく}→諸国：15992_shokoku⟧ is a more literary term for "various countries" often used in historical contexts.
